title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic: inference hooks leave beta for Claude Enterprise; Code Review GA and Opus 5.5 Fast mode GA (Oct 15)
bullets.summary: Releasebot's Anthropic feed shows inference hooks out of beta for Enterprise orgs (Oct 20), Code Review generally available and Opus 5.5 Fast mode GA (Oct 15), plus a steady run of Claude Code 2.1.29x-2.1.305 builds; this is an aggregator, not Anthropic's own notes.
bullets.how: The Construct: inference hooks and Fast mode are usable for runner guardrails and latency-sensitive agents; re-check Claude Code version on the Mac runners. PRAGMA: enterprise-hook story for client pitches. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 reportedly cancelled after internal safety tests (conflicts with yesterday's 'Terra in prep' rumor)
bullets.summary: A third-party tracker cites the WSJ saying OpenAI's October GPT-6.1 (named Astra there) was cancelled with no new date; this contradicts yesterday's TestingCatalog Terra report and I could not verify the WSJ piece directly.
bullets.how: The Construct: drop the queued GPT-6.1 benchmark until an official OpenAI release. PRAGMA: avoid telling clients a GPT-6.1 date. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Gemini 4 Argon opens to paying users (Oct 13) and DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 ships (Oct 17)
bullets.summary: The same tracker lists Google opening Gemini 4 Argon worldwide to paid users on Oct 13 and DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 on Oct 17; older than 24h and only partly verified.
bullets.how: The Construct: candidate cheap/second-opinion models for low-stakes sub-agents after a quick eval. PRAGMA: cost-comparison material. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Official-release confidence matters: this week's rumor (GPT-6.1 Terra) was contradicted by a cancellation report within a day, so gate every model change on a vendor-confirmed release plus a regression pass, and treat single-source trackers as leads, not facts.
